p: Saul was consenting unto his death: Christ uses the rage of his enemies in the spreading forth and enlarging of his kingdom.
And devout men: The godly mourn for Steven after his death, and bury him, showing in this an example of singular faith and charity: but no man prays to him.
carried Stephen to his burial: Amongst all the duties of charity which the godly perform, there is no mention made of enshrining relics.
As for Saul: The dispersion or scattering abroad of the faithful is the gathering together of churches.
Then Philip went down to the: Philip, who was before a deacon in Jerusalem, is made an evangelist by God in an extraordinary way.
But there was a certain man: Christ overcomes Satan as often as he desires, and carries him about as it were in triumph, in the sight of those whom Satan deceived and bewitched.

sorcery: The word which is used in this place was at first used of good things, and is borrowed from the language of the Persians, who call their wise men by that name; but afterwards it was used of evil things.
bewitched the people of Samaria: He had so allured the Samaritans with his witchcraft that as blind and mad idiots they were wholly addicted to him.
Then Simon himself believed also: The wicked and the highly reprobate are often forced to taste the good gift of God, but they immediately spit it out again.

Now when the apostles which were: Peter, not chief but as an ambassador sent from the whole company of the apostles, and John his companion, according to the authority which was committed unto them, strengthen, encourage, and build up the churches of Samaria, whose foundation had been laid before by Philip.
Holy Ghost: Those excellent gifts which are necessary, especially for those that were to be appointed rulers and governors of the Church.
And when Simon saw that through: Covetousness and the seeking of glory at length remove the hypocrites from their dens.
They are the successors of Simon Magus, and not Simon Peter, who either buy or sell holy things.
matter: In this doctrine which I preach.
right in the sight of God: Is not upright indeed and without the concealing of hypocritical motives.
Repent therefore of this thy wickedness: We must hope well even for the vilest sinners, as long as and as much as we can.

gall of bitterness: He calls the inward malice of the heart and the venomous and demonic wickedness with which the magician was wholly filled with the gall of bitterness: and he is said to be in the gall, as though he were wholly overwhelmed with gall, and buried in it.
bond of iniquity: Entangled in the bonds of iniquity.

And the angel of the Lord: Christ, who calls freely whom he wishes, now uses Philip, who was not thinking about any such thing, to unexpectedly instruct and baptize the eunuch, and by this means extends the limits of his kingdom even into Ethiopia.
of great authority under Candace queen: A man of great wealth and authority with Candace. Now this word "Candace" is a common name of all the Queens of Ethiopia.
guide me: To show me the way to understand it.
The place of the scripture which: Those things which seem to come most by chance or fortune (as men term it) are governed by the secret providence of God.

humiliation his judgment was taken away: The Hebrew text reads it in this way, "out of a narrow strait, and out of judgment was he taken": and by the "narrow strait" he means the grave and the very bonds of death, and by "judgment" he means the punishment which was laid upon him, and the miserable state which Christ took upon himself for our sakes, in bearing his Father's wrath.
generation: How long he will endure: for Christ, having once risen from the dead, dies no more; Ro 6:9.

And Philip said: Profession of faith is required of those being baptized, and therefore it is evident that we are not first ingrafted into Christ when we are baptized, but are already ingrafted, and then are baptized. (Ed.)
I believe that Jesus Christ is: The sum of the confession which is necessary for baptism.
